submitted.body: The owner chose username and password as the v0.3 sign-in experience. The linked draft proposes fresh setup and existing-account upgrade, sign-in and session behaviour, server invitations and recovery. Recovery fallback and session policy remain open.

submitted.body: The owner approved first-run administrator setup by QR, optional email at signup, and local server-machine recovery if the owner loses both password and recovery code. The draft proposes keeping PI-3 local with a contained phone setup trial. Public access remains the v0.5 roadmap slice, and shared multi-server sign-in is later design work.

submitted.body: The owner replaced the first-run QR proposal with an Open FoundationOS link from the local server control. The browser opens first-owner signup on an empty store or sign-in on an existing store, and valid sessions must survive refresh. The draft nominates the MUI v6 templates and proposes an HttpOnly cookie backed by session state held by the client host.

submitted.body: The owner approved the MUI sign-in and signup templates and requires valid sign-in to survive browser close as well as refresh. The updated draft plans a polished account experience, a focused review and cleanup of the current foundation, documentation and full end-to-end QA. Expiry and full local client-host restart behavior remain open.
